Support the annual (or ongoing) SOC 2 audit cycle once certified, including recurring evidence requests and control testing. Experience with onboarding/offboarding processes and coordinating access changes across multiple systems and stakeholders. Familiarity with password management tools, security awareness platforms, and endpoint protection tools. Experience supporting SOC 2 (or similar compliance framework, e.g., ISO 27001) readiness or audits, including evidence collection and control documentation — direct SOC 2 audit experience strongly preferred. Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with non-technical employees and HR/People Operations. Ability to manage competing priorities and tickets independently with minimal supervision.
